scope: Body Plans BP1–BP3; selected designs receive head variations
general: The body-plan exploration is closer, but not finished.
The heads lean too heavily on lizard shapes. Add mammalian and other skull, jaw, nose and ear structures while retaining some lizard/snake options.
Needlehip's lizard-like face, fur and whip tail illustrate an interesting combination, not a universal template.
Preserve the selected body plans and coverings while exploring restrained head variation.
